Title: Leading Causes Of Premature Death
MethodsNote: Full labels are: Malignant Neoplasms (cancer), Diseases of Heart (heart disease), Psych. Substance Use and Accidental Drug Poisoning (drug and alc use), Accidents Except Drug Poisoning (accidents), Diabetes Mellitus (diabetes), Intentional Self-Harm (suicide), Human Immunodeficiency Virus Disease (HIV), Cerebrovascular Disease (stroke), Chronic Liver Disease and Cirrhosis (liver disease), Assault (homicide). NYC data are restricted to NYC residents. Numbers are data for 2011-2015 combined.
Source: NYC DOHMH, Bureau of Vital Statistics
DenominatorSource: NYC DOHMH population estimates, modified from US Census Bureau interpolated intercensal population estimates, 2011-2015, vintage 2015
